Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description: A job applicant registration record verified against South African Department of Home Affairs (DHA) and South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA).

id.description: UID of the candidate user matching their authentication record.

firstName.description: First name of the candidate matching Department of Home Affairs records.

lastName.description: Surname of the candidate matching Department of Home Affairs records.

studentNumber.description: Unified LURITS (Learner Unit Record Information Tracking System) Student Number.

nqfLevel.description: Verified South African National Qualifications Framework (NQF) level.

institution.description: NQF accredited institution where the qualification was achieved.

dhaVerified.description: Flag representing verified status matching the Department of Home Affairs identity system.

saqaVerified.description: Flag representing verified status matching SAQA records.

verifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 server timestamp when government database integrations verified these details.

rankScore.description: AI-calculated suitability rank score for active job criteria.

matchFeedback.description: AI-generated explanation of the candidate qualification suitability.

status.description: Current vetting state of the candidate profile.

drivingLicense.description: Driving license status/type of the applicant (e.g., Code B, Code EB, None).

extraSkills.description: Comma-separated list of secondary skills (e.g., forklift, packing, retail).

linkedinImported.description: Indicates whether work experience has been imported from LinkedIn profile.

linkedinVerified.description: Indicates whether work experience has been verified against tax or employment registers.

linkedinImportedAt.description: Timestamp when candidate imported LinkedIn data.

workHistory.description: JSON serialized array of past roles and companies.

uploadedDocuments.description: Scanned credential certificates and foreign evaluation documents stored securely for state compliance audits.

Job.title: Job
Job.description: Employment opportunity posted by an employer listing NQF requirements.

HiringDecision.title: HiringDecision
HiringDecision.description: An employer's recorded decision for a job post containing a compliance sign-off.

justification.description: Detailed explanation of the hire/reject decision matching South African Labour standards.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: An immutable log of key verification actions and hiring decisions for Department of Labour audit compliance.

systemHash.description: SHA-256 integrity hash validating the block state.
